_comment: Every hub option banks chatted_with_grimalkin, the met counter his inn-guest row needs. The repo's usual producer is a talk_pool on the entity, but this Grimalkin carries a conversation and NO talk_pool, and giving him one would change what his first interact of every waking does on a shipped entity -- so the bank rides the conversation, appended LAST in each effects array so no existing effect's event order moves. All four options carry it; effects never change the rendered option list, so every index-driven script over this hub is untouched.

hub.speaker: Grimalkin
hub.text: Stand up straight when you address me. I measure everything that comes through this office, and most of it is found wanting. State your business.

options.text: I'm here for the forge-tier fitness read. (8 gold)

options._comment: b4 #219 slot gate: a held posting blocks enrollment. The board_accepted bool gate HIDES (both directions, same as Selys's hub) — no visible-locked render exists; the study-loop canonical's mutual-exclusion option pins are the proof.

Spec 4 (Task 6.2) PALLASS CAPSTONE. Placed on GRIMALKIN, not pallass_forge_clerk: the clerk says 'I only handle paper' in three separate nodes, while forge-tier rune practice is Grimalkin's professional register. Gated on the forge chain's terminal (elevator_pass_stamped) + spine_started, hidden once heard; revisit arm on the hub he already sees the player at (spec 8). Carries chatted_with_grimalkin like every other option here; the lattice bank rides the ACCEPT one node down, so declining costs nothing.
options.text: You've been about to say something since the stamp.

text_variants.text: The field subject returns. Your engagement data survived review. It is in the literature now; that is the only compliment I issue.
The casting subject. Your wind held past the eighth measure, which surprised exactly one of us. Speak.

exam.speaker: Grimalkin
exam.text: Grip, wind, and whether you quit before I do — three measures. You cleared all three. Barely, on the second. Numbers don't lie, and neither do I: you'll survive the forge tier. The file will say 'adequate.' From me, that is not an insult.

forge_runes.speaker: Grimalkin
forge_runes._comment: Held under the 200-char page budget ON PURPOSE: at 204 it split into a 191-char page plus a 12-char orphan reading only 'Stand still.', which the windowed read caught looking like a rendering fault.
forge_runes.text: I have. The forge tier runs on rune-fed work. Every ward up there eats on a schedule a smith keeps in a ledger. Feed it on time or it feeds itself. Your door has no ledger. Stand still.

options.text: I'll take that reading another day.

forge_runes_verdict._comment: HIS OWN PIECE ONLY (spec 4): rune-feeding as forge-tier maintenance practice, plus his standing objection to anything unmeasured. He does not know what is at the far end of the draw; the assembled picture is Act V's.
forge_runes_verdict.speaker: Grimalkin
forge_runes_verdict.text: It costs whatever it is drawing on, and it has been drawing unsupervised since long before you owned it. I do not find that alarming. I find it UNMEASURED, which is worse. Find what sits at the far end of the draw and bring me the numbers. I will publish them and you will be a footnote. That is the highest offer I make.

study_enrolled.speaker: Grimalkin
study_enrolled.text: Enrolled. Fight as you would; I will know if you perform for the ledger. Return when the numbers exist.
study_enrolled._comment: b4 #219 enrollment ack. board_accepted:false on the hub's studies entry blocks accept while ANY posting is held (hidden, not locked); studies are re-acceptable after completion or abandon — delta rows are repeatable.

studies.speaker: Grimalkin
studies.text: Two open protocols. Field engagements, or witnessed casting. Both pay on data, neither pays for stories.

options.text: Sign me on as a field subject. Three engagements, logged.
options._comment: b4 review fix: NO hide_when — accepted_bounty_* counters never reset, so hiding on them permanently retired the study after one accept-then-abandon (the hub's board_accepted:false gate already prevents double-accept while a posting is held; delta rows are repeatable by design).

options.text: Measure my casting. Eight witnessed, as posted.
